# Fact entities and the SQLite tables

Every scan writes each entity below to `audit-output/runs/<run-id>/data/` three times: `<entity>.json` (the source of truth), `<entity>.csv` and one table of the same name in `facts.sqlite`. The models are in `legacy_audit/model/facts.py` (`ENTITIES`, in export order); their JSON Schemas are in `schemas/facts/`.

In SQLite every column is untyped; lists and objects (evidence, operations, details, ...) are stored as JSON text, and `id` is the primary key when the entity has one. In CSV, evidence is written `file:line;file:line`, other lists are joined with `;` and objects are JSON.

Every fact has `id` (from `make_id(kind, *key_fields)`: stable across runs) and `evidence: [{file, line, snippet}]`.
